sources.authority: HM Land Registry / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 2,595,903 title boundaries from one provider; collector and new-data dates are 2025-11-26, and the polygons show the indicative position and extent of registered property.
sources.quality_effect: A title polygon is useful for spatial preparation but is indicative rather than a surveyed legal boundary and cannot be linked to a candidate without an exact relation and provenance check.

sources.source: Planning Data development corporation boundary dataset
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset lists 13 development-corporation boundaries from two providers; the collector last ran on 2026-06-30 and new data was last found on 2026-05-04.
sources.quality_effect: The boundary identifies governance and planning responsibility, not a positive development allocation or parcel-level growth score.

sources.verified_fact: The official dataset lists 233 infrastructure projects from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-21, new data was last found on 2023-09-29, and the site boundaries may change.
sources.quality_effect: Project geometry supports EIA and consultation context, but the old source-discovery date and mutable boundaries block treating it as current parcel evidence without PINS readback.

sources.source: Planning Data design code area dataset
sources.authority: MHCLG Planning Data / participating local authorities
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset lists 11 design-code areas from six providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-05 and new data was last found on 2022-07-06.
sources.quality_effect: Design-code areas can supply policy context, but the MHCLG-created origin and old source date require current local-authority code and status verification.

sources.source: Planning Data public transport access node dataset
sources.authority: Department for Transport / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset lists 363,324 public-transport access nodes from one provider; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-21.
sources.quality_effect: Access nodes are point context only; proximity, walking route, service frequency and accessibility must be computed separately before any growth score.

sources.verified_fact: The official documentation describes a consistent API across more than 100 planning and housing datasets and supports coordinate queries that return selected dataset geometries intersecting a latitude/longitude.
sources.quality_effect: This locks the future execution contract for exact point-intersection screening; it does not replace parcel polygons, dataset-specific freshness checks or acceptance validation.
